headline: Dominate TF outta LinkedIn | For established coaches & consultants ready to own their big d!ck authority, sign £15k clients & hit 5-figure MRR without sales calls | LinkedIn Creator & Strategist | Speaker | Podcast Host

posts.text: My clients ALWAYS wish they'd hired me sooner 💅🏻

I thought I knew the missing piece.
I was wrong, and humbled VERY quickly.
If you’re an established expert coach or senior consultant, you must read this.

Most people on LinkedIn are building a fan club.
I’m building a high-ticket client engine.
Here are the 5 messaging gaps losing you THOUSANDS each month 🫠

4 months ago, I moved back to the UK.
Since then, my life priorities have flipped 180.

No, you don’t need to post video content.
No, you don’t need to go viral with 100s of likes.
No, you don’t need to be "popular" + have 50k followers.

I’m done with this B$.

High-budget, self-led clients
do not give a f#ck about your:

🎤 trending audio
🎥 polished video clips

For months, I fell into the exact same trap.

I kept telling myself:

"Grace, you need to create more video content.
You need to get back on camera."

(Because yes, I talk to myself 😉)

Then I remembered
how I actually want to live my life.

I’d rather:

🏋🏻‍♀️ go to a lunchtime 1REBEL class
🥳 take impromptu days off whenever I want
💅🏼 spend the afternoon in a boujee hotel lobbies

I haven’t posted video content in approx 2 months.

And in August? 

I signed my 2 highest-paying clients to date.

Let this be your proof.

You don’t need a 4K camera.
You don’t need a video editor.

And you DEFINITELY don’t need to spend 3 hours a day filming reels just to sign a client 🫠

You need to:

💅🏼 lead with authority
💅🏼 own who the f#ck you are
💅🏼 show ready buyers why they need to hire you NOW

When your ideal client is ready to spend £2k, £5k, or £10k on high-level coaching / consulting strategy, they aren't looking to be entertained.

They want to KNOW that you can get them
results, without wasting their time.

If you can’t sign a high-ticket client using sharp, perspective-shifting text on LinkedIn, video isn't going to save you 🫠 #sorrynotsorry

You don’t need to act like a full-time content creator.

You need to start positioning yourself
like a high-status industry authority.
